name: Amplitude Analytics (Android)

dataTypes.when: Always: events you track, plus session events (autocapture default set contains SESSIONS in the Android-Kotlin SDK).

dataTypes.type: Device or other IDs / Device or other IDs
dataTypes.when: Always. Device ID is a stored ID, else a random UUID; it uses the Advertising ID (ADID) or App Set ID only if useAdvertisingIdForDeviceId / useAppSetIdForDeviceId is enabled and the module is installed.
By default. Amplitude derives city, region and country from the client IP via MaxMind GeoIP. Disabling IP tracking in the SDK leaves location properties empty.

ask: Do you call setUserId() with your own user ID? If yes, declare Personal info / User IDs.

Do you set user properties or event properties containing personal data (email, name, phone, purchases)? Declare those types (e.g. Personal info / Email address, Financial info / Purchase history for revenue events).

Have you enabled useAdvertisingIdForDeviceId or left ADID tracking on with play-services-ads-identifier present? The Advertising ID is a Device or other ID; if used for ads attribution, add the Advertising or marketing purpose.
Legacy android-sdk only: do you call enableLocationListening() (off by default since v2.40.3)? If yes, declare Location / Precise location (or Approximate, depending on the permission you hold).

Do you use Amplitude Session Replay (com.amplitude:unified-android or session-replay-android / plugin-session-replay-android)? It records the screen; declare App activity / App interactions and review masking so personal data is not captured.
Do you enable extra autocapture (screen views, app lifecycles, deep links, element interactions)? These are still App activity / App interactions.

sources.title: IP address, location, user agent, and device properties (Amplitude)

notes: Amplitude does not publish a Play Data safety guide; an Amplitude staff reply on its community says each app must answer based on what its own setup sends. Legacy com.amplitude:android-sdk is in maintenance/deprecated. Fields can be turned off with TrackingOptions (disableAdid, disableIpAddress, disableLatLng, etc.).
